name: Alley behind a bar
desc: Out the back for air, a cigarette or a fight - away from the noise and the witnesses.
tags: narrow service alley, brick wall, dumpster, bin bags, stacked beer crates, metal fire door, single wall lamp above the door, fire escape ladder, wet ground, graffiti, cigarette ends
prose: a narrow service alley behind a bar, a dumpster and stacked crates against a graffitied brick wall, one bare lamp burning over a heavy metal fire door and wet ground beneath it
note: The single door lamp is the entire light source - name it explicitly or the alley renders evenly lit and loses the pool-of-light framing that is the reason to use this place. Easy to confuse with the neon backstreet, so keep this one dim, brick and functional with no signage at all. The fire door earns its tag: it is the reason anyone is standing out here.
